lines.en: I've suffered enough, let me out of here.
Uh, I'm trying to focus on this game.
If you don't let me out of here, in the next 30 seconds,
I'm gonna tell the cops that you kept me prisoner in here,
and then you're gonna be in more trouble than you were--
- Is this water? - You wish it was water.
Dude, I gotta get out of here, so just tell me what you want, okay?
You want money, power, an ostrich?
I want you to suffer the way I suffered.
- What? - You got me grounded for two days.
So that's how long I'm gonna keep you in there.
I really shouldn't tell you this, but, uh...
- What? - You gotta promise not to tell anyone.
You see, give me the key!
I call to the stand, model Bushwell Tenet, and just the cutest little angel you've ever seen.
Tell us why you're here today.
To state that the Shae siblings are evil incarnate.
Carly played mind games with me when she was my tutor.
He locked me in a cage.
He squirted me with suspicious liquid.
He threw a cupcake at me.
You did all that stuff to me!
He brought Chuck here to throw you off your game!
Just breathe, Spencey, take a sip of water.
Come here, you little demon elf!
I'm going to take all of it!
Only if you grab me one of those cupcakes.
